title: One Little Sound
topicEn: Getting to know people and things around you

patterns.en: My name is Ali.
What's your name?

patterns.form: I am / I'm + adjective, noun or place
patterns.en: I'm a student.
This is my house.
That is my house.
It is cold.

patterns.form: What is + singular noun / this / that?
patterns.en: What is this word?
Who is at the door?
I have two books.
I want some water.

title: Asking for the Window
topicEn: Making polite requests and asking what is available

patterns.en: I'd like a sandwich.
Can I sit here?

patterns.form: Please + base verb / base verb ..., please / Could you + base verb ..., please?
patterns.en: Speak slowly, please.
Can you open the window?

patterns.form: Excuse me + request or polite interruption
patterns.en: Excuse me, where is the library?
Where is the bus stop?

patterns.form: There is + singular or uncountable noun
patterns.en: There is a book on the table.
These are my books.
There are three chairs here.
Is there a book on the table?
Are there any seats available?

patterns.form: How much + uncountable noun...? / How much + be ...? / How much + do/does ... cost?
patterns.en: How much water do you need?
How many apples do you want?
I need a pencil.
I want to learn English.
I'd like to order lunch.
You're welcome. I'm happy to help.
I like reading.

patterns.form: I don't like + noun or verb-ing
patterns.en: I don't like cold weather.
I can ride a bike.
I can't hear you clearly.

title: The Day Is New
topicEn: Invitations, questions and starting the day

patterns.en: Let's go to the park.
Would you like some tea?
When is your birthday?
How is the weather today?
Do you like apples?
I go to work by bus.

patterns.form: I wake up + optional time / cause / circumstance
patterns.en: I wake up at six.

patterns.form: I get up + optional time / purpose / circumstance
patterns.en: I get up at six thirty.
patterns.ar: أنهض من السرير الساعة السادسة والنصف.

patterns.form: In the morning + جملة / I + فعل + in the morning
patterns.en: In the morning, I drink water.

patterns.form: I brush my teeth + optional time / duration / method
patterns.en: I brush my teeth every morning.

title: I Sing My Day
topicEn: Daily habits and how often you do them

patterns.form: I have breakfast + optional time / place / company
patterns.en: I have breakfast at seven.

patterns.form: I eat + food / meal + optional time / place / circumstance
patterns.en: I eat an apple after school.

patterns.form: I + فعل بالمضارع البسيط + every day
patterns.en: I practice English every day.

patterns.form: subject + verb + at night / At night, + clause
patterns.en: At night, I read a short story.

patterns.form: I go to bed + optional time / circumstance
patterns.en: I go to bed at nine.

patterns.form: On weekends + جملة / I + فعل + on weekends
patterns.en: I play football on weekends.
patterns.ar: ألعب كرة القدم في عطلة نهاية الأسبوع.

patterns.en: I usually walk to school.
I always say good morning.
I often go to the library.
I sometimes walk to work.
I never skip breakfast.
I've got a ticket.
I need to catch the bus.
I have to study for my exam.

patterns.form: I don't have to + base verb
patterns.en: I don't have to work today.
I must wear my seat belt.
I should practice more.
You should take a short break.
Let me help you.

patterns.form: Is it okay if + subject + verb ... ?
patterns.en: Is it okay if we sit here?
patterns.ar: هل من المقبول إذا جلسنا هنا؟

patterns.en: You may use this computer.

title: Kind Words Travel
topicEn: Invitations, politeness and questions about routines

patterns.form: Would you like to + base verb ... ?
patterns.en: Would you like to join us?
Could you please repeat the last sentence?
patterns.ar: هل يمكنك إعادة الجملة الأخيرة من فضلك؟

patterns.en: May I come in, please?
patterns.ar: هل تسمح لي بالدخول من فضلك؟

patterns.en: I'd love to join the trip.

patterns.form: How about + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: How about meeting at the library?
patterns.ar: ما رأيك في اللقاء في المكتبة؟

patterns.form: Thank you for + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: Thank you for waiting for me.

patterns.form: I'm sorry for + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: I'm sorry for being late today.

patterns.form: That's all right + optional reassuring sentence
patterns.en: That's all right. We can try again.
What do you do after school?
Where do you study English?
When do you practice English?

title: Ask Me How and Why
topicEn: How, why, choices and the order of events

patterns.en: Why is the bus late?
Why do you study English?
How do you make tea?
Does she speak English?
Which one should I choose?

patterns.form: Before I + فعل مضارع، جملة رئيسية
patterns.en: Before I leave, I check my bag.

patterns.form: After I + فعل مضارع، جملة رئيسية
patterns.en: After I study, I take a break.
I was at home yesterday.
I wasn't tired yesterday.
Were you at school yesterday?

title: A Paper Boat Afternoon
topicEn: Telling stories about the past, decisions and beginnings

patterns.form: I went + to + place / I went home
patterns.en: I went to the market yesterday.
I didn't see your message.
Did you finish your homework?
I had a red bicycle as a child.
patterns.ar: كانت لدي دراجة حمراء في طفولتي.

patterns.en: I saw a rainbow after the rain.
I met an old friend at the market.
I bought bread this morning.
I made a paper boat.
I forgot to bring my book.
I decided to learn English.
I started reading a story yesterday.
I'll call you after class.
I won't be late tomorrow.
Will you join us tomorrow?
I'm going to practice English tonight.

patterns.form: I'm not going to + base verb
patterns.en: I'm not going to skip breakfast.

patterns.form: Are you going to + base verb + ...?
patterns.en: Are you going to study tonight?
I'm planning to learn ten new words.
I'm meeting my friends at six.

patterns.form: The + scheduled event + starts / leaves / opens / begins + at + time
patterns.en: The class starts at nine tomorrow.
I hope to learn English well.
I might go to the park after lunch.
patterns.ar: قد أذهب إلى الحديقة بعد الغداء.

patterns.en: I feel calm after my walk.
I'm happy with my test result.

patterns.form: I'm worried about + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: I'm worried about missing the bus.

patterns.form: I'm interested in + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: I'm interested in learning new languages.
I think this lesson is useful.

patterns.form: I agree with + person or opinion
patterns.en: I agree with your suggestion.

patterns.form: I don't agree with + person or opinion
patterns.en: I don't agree with that idea.
It takes ten minutes to get there.
patterns.ar: يستغرق الوصول إلى هناك عشر دقائق.

patterns.en: I practice English because I want to travel.
patterns.ar: أتدرب على الإنجليزية لأنني أريد السفر.

patterns.en: We were hungry, so we made lunch.

patterns.form: action + to + base verb for purpose
patterns.en: I opened the book to check the answer.
The test was hard, but I passed.
I used to walk to school.
I was reading at eight o'clock.

patterns.form: While I was + verb-ing, + past simple
patterns.en: While I was reading, the phone rang.
When I opened the door, I saw a cat.
I expect to arrive before sunset.
I may need my umbrella this afternoon.
patterns.ar: قد أحتاج إلى مظلتي بعد ظهر اليوم.

patterns.en: I'll probably take the early bus.
I'm about to leave the house.

patterns.form: If + present simple, I'll + base verb
patterns.en: If it rains, I'll stay at home.

patterns.form: When + present simple, I'll + base verb
patterns.en: When I get home, I'll call my mother.
patterns.ar: عندما أصل إلى المنزل، سأتصل بأمي.

patterns.form: As soon as + present simple, I'll + base verb
patterns.en: As soon as I finish, I'll help you.

patterns.form: I'm proud of + person or achievement
patterns.en: I'm proud of my progress in English.
I'm surprised that the shop is open.
I'm disappointed that the game was canceled.
I'm grateful for your kindness.
I feel like going for a walk.

patterns.form: I don't feel like + verb ending in ing
patterns.en: I don't feel like watching TV.
patterns.ar: لا أشعر برغبة في مشاهدة التلفاز.

patterns.en: In my opinion, we need more practice.
patterns.ar: في رأيي، نحتاج إلى مزيد من التدريب.

patterns.en: I believe everyone can learn.

patterns.form: I prefer + noun or verb ending in ing + to + alternative
patterns.en: I prefer walking to driving.
It seems like the shop is closed.

patterns.form: It sounds like + noun or clause
patterns.en: It sounds like rain outside.
patterns.ar: يبدو أن المطر يتساقط في الخارج من صوته.

patterns.form: Would you mind + verb ending in ing
patterns.en: Would you mind moving your bag?

patterns.form: Do you mind if I + present verb
patterns.en: Do you mind if I sit here?

patterns.form: I'm afraid I can't + base verb
patterns.en: I'm afraid I can't come on Friday.
patterns.ar: أخشى أنني لا أستطيع الحضور يوم الجمعة.

patterns.form: I appreciate + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: I appreciate your patience today.

patterns.form: Could you clarify + noun or what you mean
patterns.en: Could you clarify what you mean?
Let me know if the time changes.

title: Join the Lines
topicEn: Connecting reasons, purposes, contrasts and examples

patterns.form: main clause + because of + noun or gerund
patterns.en: The bus was late because of traffic.

patterns.form: reason sentence. That's why + result clause
patterns.en: I missed the bus. That's why I'm late.

patterns.form: main clause + so that + subject + can or could + base verb
patterns.en: I write notes so that I can remember more.
Although she was tired, she kept studying.
patterns.ar: رغم أنها كانت متعبة، واصلت الدراسة.

patterns.en: The book is long. However, it is easy to read.
patterns.ar: الكتاب طويل. ومع ذلك يسهل قراءته.

patterns.form: instead of + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: She chose water instead of soda.
patterns.ar: اختارت الماء بدلًا من المشروبات الغازية.

patterns.form: general idea. For example, specific illustration
patterns.en: Healthy habits help us. For example, sleep improves focus.
patterns.ar: العادات الصحية تساعدنا. مثلًا، النوم يحسن التركيز.

patterns.form: general noun + such as + example nouns or phrases
patterns.en: I enjoy fruits such as apples and oranges.
What I mean is we need more practice.
patterns.ar: ما أقصده هو أننا نحتاج إلى تدريب أكثر.

patterns.en: The reason is that the library closes early.
patterns.ar: السبب هو أن المكتبة تغلق مبكرًا.

patterns.form: I wonder if + statement word order
patterns.en: I wonder if the museum is open today.
patterns.ar: أتساءل إن كان المتحف مفتوحًا اليوم.

patterns.form: I wonder how + statement word order
patterns.en: I wonder how this machine works.
The person who helped me is my neighbor.

patterns.form: the thing or book that + relative clause
patterns.en: The song that we heard was beautiful.
She works at the café where we met last summer.
patterns.ar: تعمل في المقهى الذي التقينا فيه الصيف الماضي.

patterns.en: I managed to finish on time.
patterns.ar: تمكنت من الانتهاء في الوقت المحدد.

patterns.en: It's worth trying again.

patterns.form: Do you know where + subject + verb?
patterns.en: Do you know where the station is?

patterns.form: even though + subject + verb, main clause
patterns.en: Even though it was raining, we went outside.
patterns.ar: مع أن المطر كان يهطل، خرجنا.

patterns.en: While I enjoy reading, my brother prefers sports.
patterns.ar: بينما أستمتع بالقراءة، يفضل أخي الرياضة.

patterns.form: in addition to + noun or verb ending in ing
patterns.en: In addition to English, I study mathematics.

patterns.form: not only + parallel item + but also + parallel item
patterns.en: He is not only helpful but also patient.
patterns.ar: ليس متعاونًا فقط بل صبور أيضًا.

patterns.form: main clause + unless + present simple condition
patterns.en: We'll go outside unless it rains.

patterns.form: even if + hypothetical or possible condition
patterns.en: Even if it rains, I'll attend the event.

patterns.form: What matters is + noun or clause
patterns.en: What matters is that we keep trying.

patterns.form: Could you tell me whether + statement clause
patterns.en: Could you tell me whether the office is open?
patterns.ar: هل يمكنك إخباري ما إذا كان المكتب مفتوحًا؟

title: Words to Keep
topicEn: Memories, wishes, hypothetical situations and earlier events

patterns.en: I still think about the day when I started school.
patterns.ar: ما زلت أفكر في اليوم الذي بدأت فيه المدرسة.

patterns.form: I wish I could + base verb
patterns.en: I wish I could play the piano well.
patterns.ar: أتمنى لو أستطيع العزف على البيانو جيدًا.

patterns.form: If I were + imaginary situation, I would + base verb
patterns.en: If I were a teacher, I would make lessons fun.
patterns.ar: لو كنت معلمًا، لجعلت الدروس ممتعة.

patterns.form: If + past perfect, subject + would have + past participle
patterns.en: If I had left early, I would have caught the bus.
patterns.ar: لو غادرت مبكرًا، لكنت لحقت بالحافلة.

patterns.en: I should have brought my umbrella.
I could have taken the earlier bus.

patterns.form: I had already + past participle + before past event
patterns.en: I had already eaten when my friend called.
patterns.ar: كنت قد تناولت الطعام عندما اتصل صديقي.

patterns.form: By the time + past simple, past perfect clause
patterns.en: By the time she called, I had finished cooking.
patterns.ar: بحلول اتصالها، كنت قد أنهيت الطبخ.

patterns.form: The + comparative clause, the + comparative clause
patterns.en: We find that the more we practice, the more confident we become.
patterns.ar: نجد أنه كلما تدربنا أكثر، أصبحنا أكثر ثقة.
